source: client brief — E-2814 high-adhesion abrasion-resistant PET for oily castings & MES traceability

title.en: Full-Process Traceability for Oily Castings | E-2814 High-Adhesion, Abrasion-Resistant PET Label
title.zh: 油污铸件全流程追溯 | E-2814 强粘耐刮擦 PET 标签

subtitle.en: A 4 mil white polyester label that bonds to oily, rough castings and keeps barcodes readable through abrasion, cleaning and solvents.
subtitle.zh: 4 mil 白色聚酯标签，牢固贴合带油、粗糙铸件，经刮擦、清洗与溶剂后条码依旧清晰。

seo_desc.en: E-2814 is a 4 mil white PET thermal-transfer label with high initial tack and an abrasion-resistant topcoat for reliable barcode identification and MES traceability on oily castings, engine components and machined parts.
seo_desc.zh: E-2814 是一款 4 mil 白色 PET 热转印标签，高初粘、耐刮擦涂层，用于带油铸件、发动机部件与机加工零件的条码识别与 MES 全流程追溯。

en.label: Surfaces
en.value: Oily / rough castings, engine & machined parts

zh.label: 胶粘剂
zh.value: 高初粘、强粘接丙烯酸压敏胶

zh.label: 适用表面
zh.value: 带油/粗糙铸件、发动机及机加工零件

zh.label: 用途
zh.value: 一物一码 MES 追溯

en: Castings, engine components and machined parts often carry residual rust-preventive oil or machine oil, and have rough or textured surfaces. Conventional labels may slide, lift or detach, and printed barcodes can become unreadable after abrasion, cleaning or solvent exposure — creating gaps in MES traceability.
zh: 铸件、发动机部件及机械零件表面常残留防锈油、机油，或具有粗糙纹理。普通标签在此类表面容易打滑、起翘或脱落，条码也可能因摩擦、清洗和溶剂接触而失读，造成 MES 追溯中断。

en: Oil films reduce effective contact between the adhesive and the part
Rough casting surfaces make reliable bonding difficult
Handling and assembly expose labels to abrasion and impact
Cleaning agents and industrial solvents may damage printed data
Detached or unreadable labels interrupt MES data connections
zh: 油膜影响胶黏剂与零件表面的有效接触
铸件表面粗糙，普通标签难以牢固贴合
搬运和装配过程容易造成刮擦与碰撞
清洗剂及工业溶剂可能侵蚀打印信息
标签脱落或条码失读会中断 MES 数据关联

en: E-2814 is a white polyester thermal-transfer label stock. Application testing has demonstrated reliable identification on oily castings, engine components and parts exposed to demanding manufacturing conditions.
zh: E-2814 是一款白色热转印聚酯标签材料。通过实际工况测试，可用于带油铸件、发动机部件及严苛制造环境中的长期识别。

en.label: High adhesion
en.text: High initial adhesion and peel strength; field-verified stable bonding to oily and rough casting surfaces, reducing sliding, edge lifting and detachment.

en.label: Durable 4 mil PET film
en.text: The 0.100 mm white polyester film provides good mechanical strength for identification throughout handling, stacking and assembly.

en.label: Abrasion-resistant print coating
en.text: A specialized thermal-transfer topcoat improves resistance to abrasion, smearing and demanding environments, helping barcodes, QR codes and serial numbers stay readable.

en.label: Solvent-cleaning resistance
en.text: Designed to withstand cleaning with a variety of chemicals; a suitable thermal-transfer ribbon further improves solvent and abrasion resistance of the printed data.

en.label: MES traceability support
en.text: Carries material batch, mould number, production team, equipment parameters and inspection status — building an item-level 'one part, one code' quality record.

en.label: Selection & testing tip
en.text: Actual performance depends on oil type, oil-film thickness, surface roughness, application pressure, temperature and ribbon combination. Before volume use, run adhesion, dwell, abrasion, cleaning and scan tests under your real operating conditions.

zh.label: 强粘接性能
zh.text: 较高的初粘力和剥离强度；现场验证可稳定粘贴于带油及粗糙铸件表面，降低打滑、起翘和脱落风险。

zh.label: 4 mil 耐用 PET 面材
zh.text: 0.100 mm 白色聚酯薄膜具有良好的机械强度，适合零件搬运、堆放及装配过程中的长期标识。

zh.label: 耐刮擦打印涂层
zh.text: 特殊热转印打印涂层可提高图文对刮擦、蹭污和严苛环境的耐受性，帮助条码、二维码及 SN 码保持清晰。

zh.label: 耐溶剂清洗
zh.text: 材料可耐受多种化学品清洗环境；搭配适用的热转印碳带，可进一步提高打印信息的耐溶剂和耐擦拭性能。

zh.label: 支持 MES 全流程追溯
zh.text: 可承载原材料批次、模具编号、生产班组、设备参数和检验状态等信息，建立“一物一码”的质量追溯档案。

zh.label: 选型提示
zh.text: 具体表现会受到油品种类、油膜厚度、表面粗糙度、贴标压力、温度及碳带组合影响。批量应用前，建议按实际工况完成粘接、静置、摩擦、清洗和扫码测试。

en: Industrial equipment name and rating plates
Barcode identification on oily or rough surfaces
zh: 汽车发动机舱零部件标识
发动机缸体及铸件追溯
机械零件与喷涂金属部件
工业设备名称及参数铭牌
